shortDescription: Polymarket’s "Real Madrid vs. Rayo Vallecano" submarket for "Real Madrid second-half goals over 0.5" saw the "Over" probability swing sharply from 83.5% one hour earlier to 65.5%, an 18% move. According to ChainCatcher, the sudden change may reflect the impact of breaking news.
